en: The image depicts a historical scene with two prominent buildings, separated by a gated entrance. Several uniformed soldiers and a woman in period attire are standing or walking in the courtyard. The architecture is typical of late 19th to early 20th century European styles, with red-tiled roofs, arched windows, and decorative cornices. There are leafy trees partially shading the image. The text 'Graz.' and 'Bahnhofskaserne.' is printed on the upper part of the postcard, and a street sign reading 'Gartenstr.' is visible on the right building.
